headline: Warrant article adding $500,000 to the capital improvement plan passed unanimously; officials discussed tax cap ballot measure and town budget.
summary: Officials discussed House Bill 1300 and House Bill 1331, the town's tax cap and budget, school capital projects, state school funding, and joint purchasing. A warrant article adding $500,000 to the capital improvement plan passed unanimously.
decisions: Warrant article adding $500,000 to the capital improvement plan passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: A warrant article adding $500,000 to the CIP passed unanimously.

decision_titles: $500,000 added to the capital improvement plan by warrant article
